queue.title: Selective terminal rescoring of one-step shortlist
Cost-tier-constrained selective terminal rescoring
queue.hypothesis: Useful terminal-planning overrides are concentrated among cost-neutral or cost-reducing first actions; forbidding cost-increasing overrides will reduce harmful heterogeneity.

checkpoint.next_action: Run seed 61001 atomically, persist result, then continue sequentially under the frozen cost-tier gate.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Historical breadth benefits are not transferable without exact executable lineage; benchmark v2 n=48 does not support unconditional width-2 superiority.

Simple breadth thresholds, local-margin depth gates, model-disagreement bonuses, proposal diversification, edge-centric utility replacement, posterior-state gating, calibration correction, and variance-reduced EIG racing were falsified prospectively.
Fresh benchmark v2 has frozen executable mechanics, exact 29,281-DAG support, budget 15, strict RNG isolation, and source-addressed lineage.
EXP-002R12 falsified exhaustive full-horizon terminal VOI: alignment worsened and compute averaged 37.7x, despite a terminal-regret anomaly.

EXP-002R13 selective top-3 terminal rescoring improved mean terminal edge error by 0.133, mean Brier by 0.00436, true-DAG mass by 0.0230, and net MAP by 3 at 6.62x compute, but failed preregistration because only 5/12 worlds were strict wins and the paired 95% interval [-0.459,+0.160] crossed zero. Treatment heterogeneity, not mean direction, is now the primary uncertainty.
R14 exploratory analysis found no clean confidence-margin gate; a possible cost-tier interaction is hypothesis-generating only and is being tested prospectively in R15.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
